threat_event: Nation-state actor pre-positioned in OT networks triggers coordinated outages across transmission and distribution
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Utilities are named targets in federal advisories; living-off-the-land techniques evade signature detection; monitoring gaps at distribution substations (R-007)
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01; SYS-02; SYS-04; SYS-05; BP-01; BP-02
regulatory_driver: N22-R01 (CIP-005-7; CIP-007-6 R4; CIP-008-6); NERC EOP-004-4; Form DOE-417; SEC Form 8-K Item 1.05; Reg S-K Item 106
existing_controls: Separate OT domains; Intermediate Systems with MFA; OT sensors at control centers and medium impact substations; E-ISAC threat sharing; annual OT red team
treatment_plan: Expand OT sensors to all fiber-connected distribution substations (POAM-004); threat hunts each quarter on OT; joint exercise with the Reliability Coordinator
key_risk_indicator: OT sensor coverage; hunt findings; time to detect in red team

threat_event: Attacker uses a vendor remote support path into the ADMS and issues unauthorized switching commands
threat_source: Cybercriminal or nation-state actor using a compromised vendor
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: ADMS vendor support appliance held a persistent tunnel outside the jump hosts (found 2026-08-12, disabled 2026-08-13); 64 vendors have remote access paths into OT
regulatory_driver: Voluntary benchmark (OT-STD-01); NERC EOP-004-4; Form DOE-417; SEC Form 8-K Item 1.05; Reg S-K Item 106
existing_controls: Jump hosts with MFA and session recording for 63 of 64 vendor paths; DCC enables sessions per request; SOC alerts on sessions outside windows
treatment_plan: Rebuild vendor support through the jump hosts and OT PAM (POAM-001); quarterly vendor path discovery scan; contract clause banning persistent connections
key_risk_indicator: Vendor paths outside PAM (target 0); sessions outside approved windows

threat_event: ADMS failover to the backup DCC takes longer than the 2-hour RTO during a cyber event or disaster
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2026-04-21 failover took 5 h 20 min; database synchronization is manual
existing_controls: Warm standby at OCN; paper switching and radio dispatch; annual failover test
treatment_plan: Automate database synchronization; retest by 2027-03-31 (POAM-005)

threat_event: Ransomware on corporate IT spreads to the OMS, the ADMS DMZ, and billing systems
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Large IT estate (15,800 endpoints); corporate rules into the ADMS historian (R-025); billing depends on the CIS
regulatory_driver: N22-R01 (CIP-005-7 R1 at OT boundaries); Fla. Stat. 501.171 worked example (each state where affected individuals reside); SEC Form 8-K Item 1.05; Reg S-K Item 106
existing_controls: EDR on all endpoints; immutable backups; separate OT domains; 24x7 SOC
treatment_plan: Remove corporate-to-historian rules (POAM-002); annual enterprise ransomware exercise with the disclosure committee (POAM-011)
key_risk_indicator: EDR coverage; mean time to contain

threat_event: A bulk remote disconnect command from a compromised or misused AMI account cuts power to tens of thousands of customers
threat_source: Insider or attacker with stolen credentials
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One command can disconnect up to 50,000 meters with one approver; 37 users hold the bulk role, including staff serving Utility Services clients
existing_controls: MFA on the head-end; SOC alert on bulk commands over 1,000 meters
treatment_plan: Enable two-person approval and a 500-meter per-command limit; reduce the bulk role to 8 users (POAM-018)
key_risk_indicator: Users with bulk role; bulk commands without second approval

threat_event: Attacker spoofs master commands to legacy serial gateways that cannot authenticate the ADMS
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 159 distribution substations use legacy serial-to-IP gateways without authentication
existing_controls: Gateways sit on private LTE or radio with network access lists; OT sensors at 41% of substations
treatment_plan: Replace legacy gateways (54 in 2027, the rest by 2028-12) (POAM-003)

threat_event: Intrusion at a distribution substation goes undetected because the site has no OT network monitoring
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: OT sensors at 171 of 418 distribution substations (41%)
existing_controls: Sensors at control centers and medium impact substations; ADMS alarms on unexpected device state
treatment_plan: Sensors at all 255 fiber-connected substations by 2027-12; radio sites use gateway logs (POAM-004)

threat_event: Attacker compromises an EMS Intermediate System or other EACMS and reaches high impact BES Cyber Systems
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Intermediate Systems are reachable from the corporate network by design; EMS vendor remote access
existing_controls: MFA, encryption, and session recording on Intermediate Systems; quarterly access verification; CIP-007-6 R4 logging with 15-day reviews; baseline monitoring (CIP-010-4 R2)
treatment_plan: Phishing-resistant MFA for all Interactive Remote Access (2026-12); OT red team on the EMS boundary in 2027
key_risk_indicator: Failed Intermediate System logons; baseline deviations

threat_event: Coordinated physical attack on Substation P damages 500 kV transformers

vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Substation P is a CIP-014-3 critical station; perimeter barrier slipped from 2026-06-30 to 2027-03-31

treatment_plan: Complete the barrier by 2027-03-31; document the R5 timeline revision; interim guard post (POAM-025)

threat_event: Vandalism or ballistic attack on distribution substations

threat_event: BES Cyber System Information exposed in a general collaboration site is used to target the EMS

threat_event: Customer SSNs and bank account numbers are stolen from the CIS or the export area

threat_event: An insider exports the full customer table and sells or leaks it
